visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of female hands with manicured nails opens a black circular makeup compact to reveal a beige powder cake that has shattered into several pieces. The compact is held over a white crumpled tissue on a beige surface. (2) The hands flip the compact over, revealing the back, and use a thin metal pin tool to push through a small hole, causing the old metal pan to detach. (3) The detached pan is placed on the tissue while the empty compact is held. A clear spray bottle is used to apply liquid to the compact's interior and a white tissue. (4) The hands vigorously wipe the inside of the black compact and its mirror with the tissue, removing all powder residue until the plastic shines under the bright indoor lighting. (5) A new powder refill is taken out of its white cardboard packaging and aligned with the empty compact. The person's face is briefly reflected in the small compact mirror. (6) The new pan is pressed into place and a yellow sponge is used to firmly push the edges down. The video concludes with a thumbs-up gesture holding the sponge.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: POV:沈浸式換粉餅. [Subtitle]: 又碎掉了. (2) [Subtitle]: 通常後面都有一個洞 先把舊的拿出來. (3) [Subtitle]: 開始用酒精擦拭. (4) [Variety]: 噴噴噴. (5) [Variety]: 擦擦擦. (6) [Subtitle]: 不要浪費 換個面繼續擦. (7) [Subtitle]: 這部片的重點來囉. (8) [Subtitle]: 把芯裝進去. (9) [Subtitle]: 用海綿壓緊 確定有黏好. (10) [Subtitle]: 順便也把海綿洗乾淨 (後來先晾乾，才放進盒子裡).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks a brief introductory phrase in Mandarin with a casual, upward inflection. Background music consists of a high-tempo Korean pop track featuring a bright synthesizer melody and a driving electronic drum beat. (2) A sharp, metallic 'click' sound is heard, indicating a physical detachment of parts. (3) Three rapid 'psst' sounds of an aerosol spray are followed immediately by high-frequency rhythmic rustling sounds resembling paper being manipulated. (4) The music continues at a steady pace while the scraping and rubbing sounds of tissue against plastic create a textured percussive layer in the audio mix. (5) A resonant 'snap' sound marks the final assembly, followed by the music swelling slightly in volume during the outro.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a practical 'ASMR-style' tutorial on how to replace a shattered powder refill in a makeup compact, specifically using a metal tool to eject the old pan and cleaning the case before installing a new one.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The Shu Uemura brand compact and its specific refill system are shown in detail as the focus of the tutorial.
